name: Hawaii County, HI
findings: Hawaii County has 641 nonprofit organizations. 244 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 185 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hawaii County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.
